key_insight: HorizON extends single-value battery property prediction to cycle-dependent specific-capacity trajectories using full battery-stack representations.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports long-term performance prediction, inverse design, and process optimization for organic batteries with reduced reliance on critical metals.
method: Uses a multi-fidelity, multi-horizon Deep Operator Network.
Jointly learns DFT redox potentials and cycle-dependent specific capacity.
Incorporates complete battery stacks and usage conditions to capture component interactions.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes training on battery-stack representations and usage conditions but reports no dataset size, quantitative accuracy, or validation results.
watch_item: Reliability on unseen stack chemistries and cycle horizons remains unestablished in the abstract.
paper_title: HorizON: A Multi-Horizon Deep Operator Network for Property Prediction of Organic Battery Stacks
